word-became-flesh.title: Ekereri Ekabeire Omobere
word-became-flesh.summary: Kobwateeria Ekereri ria Nyasae riendeke aremo bweri kubogu Jesus Kristo.

0.title: Ekereri riari Nyasae
0.explanation: Yohana tabaigia ekereri etoreta ritagatatari chinkorago kire na obwonto bwanyasae. Agokora abeire echinzi ekereri riari Nyasae kandi riari hamwe na Nyasae. Ogokania bwe’etegesi ya Apostolic Oneness, ekereri nigo obotaramu bwamanyasia Nyasae obwabeire abanto, kore ekereri kore Nyasae omosikera. Ndome ya mbere yakwatanete ekereri na esesere, ndome ya 14 ekaba inaigete ekereri nk’obogima bwa abanto. Kugusboka bw’eki, ekaramu y’ekereri kia Nyasae ekeiginetre kogima kw’omonto, ario Jesus Kristo.
0.hook: Yohana oroigia ngarora ekereri nk’o Nyasae. Ndome y’ebitabu engine egokorote origeranio re ekereri esesere.

1.title: Chinchobagete nigo Ekereri
1.explanation: Yohana tebagi chinkoreire chonke chireteete n’ekereri. Ekereri rie eri ekebate ekeng’ina ya Nyasae, nigo kindakiro che Nyasae na chinkoreire. Ekereri ekaiagwa Genesis, Nyasae akora ogusoma, chinchobagete choka. Yohana obaete mbere ate Ekereri riari Nyasae. Rie wagere ndome ya 14 riakora ate Ekereri riarotaga omonto, ekemera otera omonto nakorotire Nyasae. Ekereri ria Nyasae riendeke ekeigetwe kogima kw’omonto, ario Jesus Kristo.
1.hook: Chinchobagete chonke chiri chiokoreire ebiasire n’ekereri. Zaburi 33 yagonkeria origeranio rya Obotaramu bwa Nyasae kogoku ogeri n’ekereri rye.

2.title: Ebisekani bi’Omotabuari Omong’ina
2.explanation: Zaburi 33 yagonana Ekereri ria Nyasae na obuchechego bw’omotabuari omong’ina yenyamaigo kobwananiira Nyasae. Gominto ogenderere ekero Nyasae erorete chinchobagete kw’ebiasire n’obotaramu bwe ogeri, tagokorire obotse bwo Nyasae n’ebokora bakebe ebw’ogonche. Iki nigo muhimu kw’erigeranio rya Ekereri enyora Yohana. Ekereri kaneno karatakagwa bwate n’obotaramu bwa Nyasae kunye na chibesa chi’omeria ekereri erinde Nyasae,
2.hook: Omotabuari omong’ina omerete Nyasae ari kogoka chinkoreire n’Ekereri rye na obuchechego. Yohana 1:14 nigo iguru: ekereri rionserene omonto.

3.title: Gikuru
3.explanation: Yohana akora ate Ekereri rionserene omonto oko ndimwa neu bwakiagiranyi. Tagosogoti Ekereri rikoretechete omonto ahotire gotamioka ogokire ogotengereria. Ekereri geria Nyasae ne ndome ya mbere gieenete ndimo bw’omonto Kristo Jeesus. Abaisaite baameire k’agonanako kirengo, koramu na omogano. Ogokania Apostolic Oneness igokora ate Nyasae omonyene ne agokonane omonto, tugechera omobere, obokano, obone, na obinto bwonse Kristo Jeesus obwabeire oba gionse goonto.
3.hook: Ekereri tagokwate konyora omonto. Ekereri rionkwate omonto. Luka 1:35 agoigera etabukutera omocheni gotebwa Omwana wa Nyasae.

4.title: Omwana omoyakiwete gotebwa Moigo
4.explanation: Gabriel agokora ate Omoyagwaito (Holy Ghost) akanyagira Maria ne obotaramu bwa Nyasae bobw'aeng'ina obwokwaasya; neng'aki oirangete omocheni oyagara gotebwa Moigo wa Nyasae. Ekereri ekeng'ana bwate identity (identity) ya omocheni eyari ekeresia Nyasae yaring'ana kw'ironda. Nigo gigaate ringenene bw'omonto Kristo Jeesus obwabeire omotechi, tagenire ate Ekereri ne yabeire tegendi kwongera konyora. Ekereri ogetinia goiga omotabuari omong'ina wa Luka, na declaration ya Yohana igendererete Ekereri riane Nyasae.
4.hook: Luka agokora ate kitabu kia Moigo wa Nyasae kw'ironda ne bwokorwa. Ogendererete moigano wa Moigo kugendera bwomonto bwereire.

son-was-born.title: Omwana Omoigoire
son-was-born.summary: Tegera erinda rya Obwanana bwa Mwana obwokiire koborwa, omoibo, obweranyani bwa omonto, na chibararo chie ogokomanya abantu.

0.title: Omwana omogoirwe, Omwana omoniteire
0.explanation: Enkebesa  ya Isaiah enyora Erinde roi Omwana oria oigoire roborwa na Omwana omoniteire, nigo ebekabereka amagoro gose agokora amanyara arietose 'Ebiruoge Ekemwamu' na 'Tata Omokirang’a.' Enkebesa eo egokorokia echtuko chi oboisake bwa Esani na obocharekwe bwa Nyasae. Omonyakeni we Apostolic Oneness, 'Omwana' ogotebekania oboisike obwokaniire omonto na obochogo bwenene bwa Jesu, eyio Nyasae omoga omochando okoborera obotoera rero obwokiire igo. Enkebesa iyi egokorokia magaka alle abwaki, n’goikoima kobwatochi obwosi bwabwo obokoborera Endagano ya Omwana eria yatakaire gose enyama indi enyasae abwaki erokraire reference ying’ina.
0.hook: Isaiah ogosobanya omwana ogoirwe nabo Nyasae omobere. Luka nigo akobwateire oyio Omwana oria oinche etarirwe oborora.

1.title: Ndio ekobwatiwa Omwana
1.explanation: Gabrieli akorokia Maria ng’ana Ekeeng’aki Esani ekirogora na omwana omokirigwe nobweya ogokobwatiwa Omwana wa Nyasae. 'Ndio' ya Luka egosumikiria rondere Esani iyaga korokia otiyakaniire obosira bw’ Ekeeng’aki omorwa omoibo. Nkorotia ya Apostolic Oneness egokobwata Omwana ogochiekwa gose omonto moria ogoirwe omorwa omochando, nyamara Ria Nyasae yerekaneire egoterori. Enkebesa iyi ekerakorete ng’ana Nyasae otang’eteire kwe Maria, ogotebere anene ebina okoba ekore korera oboseirikani bwa Esani omomura Referensi ya Omwana ire obochando buria okoboria kororanasie.
1.hook: Malaeika agokobwata omogosīroria Omwana wa Nyasae na omwana omokirigwe n’ Ekeeng’aki Esani. Paolo nigo angetegeria bonyora obwanana obe ebwokiire omoboigo.

2.title: Akorwa munda ya omokungu
2.explanation: Paolo agokoba oti, ekigiriria yatekaga, Nyasae akora omwana enyang’ina, akorwa-munda ya omokungu na akorwa-munda ya chibesa chia abaisi. Emenyete egokobwata obwosi bw’okorokwa kwe Kristo na echibararo chie chiesaareto abandu abaisi chibesa. Nkorotio ya Apostolic Oneness egokong’ania abwaki Nyasae egachikiire egwokeranio bwabona bukora omomura omwana. Ogete, Paolo ekobata oti Nyasae akora Omwana We. Enkebesa iyi ogotebere ebina egoka okobwata ekenge oro abwaki ow’omwana na Ebitaratariamo ebiriekano.
2.hook: Omwana akorwa munda ya omokungu na anengariria oboserengeta obw’obwankiire chibesa. Luka obwatiera enyamari igokogokwa esikereria: Yesu obaki orora.

3.title: Omwana oyo ororera reriki
3.explanation: Luka agokobwata Yesu oboramire erengerereria, obwosi goise, na erengereria obokangi na Nyasae amu ndogo. Nigo abwaki amanyara abwe omonto, n’goborie chiogomi. Oro omoni ritinye ekobarogania ekire, kobariria Nyasae yokeririe oyire eng’ani ya Yesu. Emenyete esekerania boo: Yesu arenchirie obokang’i obw’omonto moria, na Obosese bw’ Nyasae yiekana moire omony'ama bwe.
3.hook: Yesu ororera erengereria obwosi na goise. Ebikano bi bro bakano ogokomena: erinde rye omonto ryie ekorigereria chiokora chie oyo omotari obwayi odereti Nyasae na abandu.

4.title: Omonto Yesu Kristo
4.explanation: Paolo agokobwata oti iribe Nyasae omochando n’ oyio omoni ebwankiire Nyasae n’abandu, Yesu Kristo Omonto, oyio ogoririe omanyara. Omoni oyo obwankiire arenge omonto, bene akorwate araniare abaisekane aboraire. Enkebesa eiyongeti Nyasae riya ariananie nigo agokobwara na Nyasae omochando are gira mokora. Egokobwata amaguta aire okwamochando Nyasae, ogotebere obwankiire ya Yesu Kristo yerekaneire omonto areniare okomeka abandu.
4.hook: Paolo agokobwata Yesu Kristo Omonto, yona omoni ebwankiire Nyasae n’abandu. Pathway ire enke egokobwata oronde ogotakaire Tata oriare okorora n’okoramanya omowe oyo Omwana.

father-dwells-in-son.title: Abaange Baisungani Moe Monene
father-dwells-in-son.summary: Okobwateeria enyamio ya Yesu yenyene nekuasa kokoba Aabasae aari nabe kandi akora nabere eye.

0.title: Okobwateeria Yesu, okobwateeria Abaange
0.explanation: Yesu abwateeria abaisani bake oigo okoba gotamanya Yesu kilosia gotamanya Abaange naenene. Konyora kwa Philippo omotariwi okororu oiraiti, abaisani bataratiga kworereira empome y’eragwabo. Yesu ndakorete ekero kobasae moeni omonto orareba ogwende, obwabo abaange omonto omwomo, morete gotamasira Obwateeri. Omonto owene, amaneno n'okora kwe nibyo bigosisa Abaange. Endebari ebaire mberi n’eng’aini eyo etebereire ko Abaange atebereirie ogendi soni obwabe fa Yesu.
0.hook: Yesu amanyete ai gotamanya yeye kilosia gotamanya Abaange. Kobwateeria kwa Philippo koiga abwate erinde Abaange nigo omonya Yesu abwateeria empome gose.

1.title: Okobona Yesu, okobona Abaange
1.explanation: Philippo abwateeria Yesu naigo abatekeria Abaange. Yesu abwansia, 'Oyo oyirete omobona ndii, omonye Abaange.' Ndakorire ekero kobaire omogaka ye Abaange araiga gotarireto. Omonto ogwende, amaneno n’okomanya kwe nibyo bigosa Abaange. Ebean’go Yesu akorania isio, abwateeria ko Abaange okororoka nabe kandi omenya kora. Endagano y’Apostolic Oneness eisa abaange goteba gotambira nari ogwenda, ndagonera omonto ogwabe oria okoreta Esani y’Abaange.
1.hook: Yesu abwansia korendera Abaange airinga eye. Amenya kera: Abaange okororoka nabe kandi okora ibindi ebia koreka.

2.title: Abaange okororoka kandi akora
2.explanation: Yesu abwateeria ai okorabora mu Abaange, kandi Abaange okororoka mune Yesu, kandi emali ese oiria akora neba Abaange okororoka nabe. Okokora nigo gori mbeni ko ogotonda kw’agosani babiri abamura obi. Endagano y’Apostolic Oneness eisa go Abaange ogwete abana naenene okororoka kandi akora mu Esani. Nengane, Yohana anyora Yesu akwendera ogege Abaange, kandi akomanya oyio. Endebari egendererwe ekerere nomanya otegendi tombe gotamba gumwoyo w’Abaange gose boegere bwa Yesu omo Esani.
2.hook: Emali se nigo abaange goro ene omwabo Yesu. Paulo naenene aireta obokora bwi omwabo: Abaange airate omwabo mu Kristo aberia ensi yose.

3.title: Abaange aireta omwabo mu Kristo
3.explanation: Paulo anyora ko Abaange aireti omwabo mu Kristo aberia ensi kandi akagokora ko obwateeri bw’obogonero bw’abantu buragereria. Abaange ntagete beerwa gotamba, naitaro arereire omwabo ogendi oyio nogotonda embasa y’obwateeri. Emasani y’okorania Kristo nigo obwateeri bwa Abaange obwatei naabo obwacho. Someria endebari ebaire mberi bieri, ebetebereire omodomo gwa Abaange, okora kwa Kristo, na obotumwa bw’abatumwa, nokotiga gotamba miloranyo igo irenda gotimomberia gospel.
3.hook: Obwateeri nigo okora kwa Abaange omwabo mu Kristo. AbaColossaiigo gekebia omwara ogwende gotoba gotamba omweri: Kore embande gose go Abaange gachire mu Kristo.

4.title: Obosani bwose obororoka mu Kristo omo mwiri
4.explanation: Paulo anymore ko obosani bwose bw’Abaange obororoka omo mwiri riya Kristo. Nekereria na Yohana 14, igoirete amanyire ko Abaange aguardoroka mu Esani: Yesu ndamura goenda ogwete ogenda ogosani ogwa Abaange. Endagano y’Apostolic Oneness eisa Abaange gotamba gochirete gose mu Yesu Kristo. Kobe eno ekorokera omonto ogwabe Yesu gose, to ekongera Abaange goenda bori ereta izina rindi ya mwiri wa Yesu.
4.hook: Obosani bwose bwa Abaange bochire mu Kristo omo mwiri. Kibera kera,ke pathway giosisa omwondo ogwago: Esechi Abaange ogorire kororoka kandi gotamanya mu Yesu?

jesus-image-of-god.title: Yesu Nigo Esabasi ya Nyasae
jesus-image-of-god.summary: Rata ka Nyasae ontama atarorogwe obwate rorobe ko Yesu Kristo, na ka nigo twamanya ogotarianga ekeng’ana keenene pa Nyasae orore.

0.title: Nyasae ontama ayomosire
0.explanation: Yohana agokwana ogoti, omonto tarang’eti Nyasae omonte korende okorora. Yesu ndiye Omwana Nyasae ontindiire, nigo ayomosete Nyasae. Nyasae okorende kororogwa oria ontama; kwonta, nyarikenene ye Yesu Kristo ndabwo twatei Nyasae. Ekereto kia Ekyangai kioria kirorere, Yesu tararirwete abere omong'ani abwate itanatekete biae Nyasae. Obore bw’Erianda ria Apostolic Oneness bwatereka Yesu (Omwana) karia obosabaane bwa Nyasae ontama atarorogwa—atikirigwa tonyone oko Nyasae oboitoreete mu Yesu ogorire orwo arate omonto. Tarari oko erikora Nyasae eng’ombe yake yarekane ogotoma Yesu oyo ogotindana.
0.hook: Yohana abwate nuwe ogotangani Nyasae ontama okorende kororogwa. Yesu oyang’ania Filipo, nigo rianyete erikora kia Nyasae mu bwabere bwo omonto.

1.title: Obere bwaye oRogati Yesu
1.explanation: Filipo arigi nigo agokwana ogoti, 'Ratete baba' (Nyasae Omogati), Yesu aronke ogokwana oyang’ana ko ore mwana arire. Rianyete niende baba ayamosete mu magana na amabege Yesu. Bwire tigwaterei erikora ria baba ontama atindaniire tarie Yesu; hande, abaiseni babwire baba oyete wendi Yesu Kristo. Ebitabu ebire oboireta egento, oko Baba orietere amagerani gose ekorani mu Yesu.
1.hook: Yesu agokwana, omonto arorire Yesu nigo arorire Nyasae Omogati. Paulo abwate ogotoma ogoti: Kristo nigo esabasi ya Nyasae atarorogwa.

2.title: Esabasi ya Nyasae ontama atarorogwa
2.explanation: Paulo arora Kristo nigo esabasi ya Nyasae atarorogwa, na arorerani ogotoma, ebinto bienge byose bikobwe ekerigia na ebya Yesu, nigo ebiekorerani. ‘Esabasi’ ino obwate tae example ya ogwatigia obosani. Nyasae ontama atarorogwa, nigo ayomosete mu Kristo, na oboeso bwe bogotoma busagetera ebinto bienge byose. Erianda rya Apostolic Oneness rieteka nu Nyasae Okobwate ninde ayomosete mu Yesu. Ogo ekegento ‘omogwatia sobu bose’ kimenyete esabasi ya Kristo gochera ninde obwate rituko kialo chiyomba abwate, hande ring’onabe ogoti ninde yacorerete gaki.
2.hook: Kristo nigo esabasi irotorete ya Nyasae ontama atarorogwa. Egento gikora: Esabasi ino ni egento ekege kobere ose?

3.title: Emariota ya bosani yachanete
3.explanation: Paulo abwate emariota yose yachenete mu Kristo. Ekitabu ekongera egento giki, emariota eno ninde Nyasae oria ayete esama abanto bemerane nabo kokwa omotagatani gose egento gia obwate Yesu yaregani ogwechimwa obosani. Kristo ninde ayomosete Nyasae ontama atarorogwa si amagambo ase, ebwe bogotoma bwa Nyasae bugotiga mu momondi, are na erikora ryake ringeniti omonto na kuemo. Kolosai 2:9 nigo yongera ebande are emariota ino ninde Emariota ya Godhead (Godhead) echanete mu chibare chi Yesu.
3.hook: Paulo agokwana emariota yose yachanete mu Kristo. Ekitabu kia Abaria kioria, Omwana nigo ekemayoka ya bogotoma na esabasi ekebwate ogotoma Nyasae.

4.title: Esabasi ekegamatekete
4.explanation: Ekitabu kia Abaria kioria, Omwana ninde mwenyanio wa bogotoma bwa Nyasae na ekebwate bosani yikeza y'ente, baria ate nigo atigania ebinto bienge byose ngarora amagambo ake. Igento ino ibwate ta oboke wa aroroire ate, oboke ga Omwana ogochimwa nemobwate biachangerete, niende enka Kristo abwate ogochimwa, nga ninde omonto bwang'ani. Erianda rya Apostolic Oneness rebwate Omwana ninde esabasi y'eborere bigotoma bwa Nyasae mu irongano, taraibwate omonto arong’aniire na Nyasae enge ekeende.
4.hook: Ekitabu kia Abaria kioria, Omwana nigo esabasi ekegamatekete ya bogotoma bwa Nyasae. Empitakano igo ikurugu gokia: emariota yose ya Godhead (Godhead) echane mu Yesu chibare.
